title: Require Research SDK Package Topology
forbids: subject-owned study material in the shared SDK, implicit package surfaces, or a controller-shaped package root
why: The research SDK is one generic package with an Effect-neutral contract root and explicit core/runtime subpaths.
remediate: Keep neutral contracts, core capabilities, runtime resources, tests, and package metadata in their declared roots; keep study content in its owner repository.
message: Research SDK package topology must remain explicit and subject-neutral.
